title: [Always Leveling] Free browser idle RPG — the Ancient Ruins event is live with a free 300 AL$ chest (premium currency, no purchase needed)
author: benedictc92
selftext:
Always Leveling is a free web-based idle RPG (playable in browser, no download): [https://www.alwaysleveling.com](https://www.alwaysleveling.com)

Why now: The Ancient Ruins event runs until Sep 30, 23:59 UTC. Every account can claim a one-time Bonus Chest with 300 AL$ (the premium currency) from the Event Shop, and the event has its own shop, achievements with new titles, and a golem mini-game. Enough AL$ to unlock most premium packs comes from just playing.

New players catch up fast: anyone well below the top of the ladder gets the Catch-Up Boost automatically. That's x5 EXP from every battle and gather, plus x3 gathered materials, x3 battle drops and x3 gold from your crew. No timer, no clock. It stays on until you've caught up.

What's in the game:

* 4 mutually exclusive build pathways (Physical, Defense, Magical, Elusive) with APEX, Ascendant and Pinnacle tiers, plus Cross Mastery to steal nodes from rival trees and a separate AL Mastery tree on top
* Gear crafting and upgrading to Lv. 20, artifacts, blessings, titles, and pets up to the new Eternal rarity
* Co-op dungeons (up to 3 players) with weekly M+ rewards and a Rally button to call for party members from global chat
* A daily Endless Boss damage race, PvP Arena, leaderboards, live chat, and a player-run Auction House
* A Central Bank: deposit Gold, Tokens or AL$ and earn daily compounding interest, plus an Exchange desk to convert what you farm into more AL$
* Full idle/offline progression: your Workers and Mercenaries gather and farm for up to 24h while you're away
* A new "Analyze" breakdown after every fight showing damage by source and what each effect actually did
* Works on a phone. Tooltips, unlearning, and the battle card all run on touch now.

Coming up: the Monster Menagerie, an auto-battler built from the monsters you fight, is in open alpha under Events right now if you want to break it before it becomes a real mode.

AI disclosure: I'm a solo dev and I build this game with AI coding tools. The design, balance decisions and every mechanic are mine; the AI helps me write and check the code. The in-game help assistant (br-AI-n) is also AI, and it only answers from the game's own Field Guide.

You can start as a guest with zero signup and save your progress later. Come grab the chest before the Ruins close.
